description.narrative: There is a problem with the formulation of the quantitative indicator in the contract (Train at least two members of staff from each partner financial institutions on best practices.) and in particular its Final Target value, where two factors are taken into account (number of staff and number of PFIs). One solution would be to replace it with two quantitative indicators measuring e.g. a) number of staff members trained and b) number of PFIs whose staff members have been trained. Alternatively, the indicator could be converted to a qualitative one which would combine the two factors in one. This is the approach followed here.
